sections.content: Use *más*...*que*, menos...que, *tan*...*como* and different descriptive structures to compare ways of speaking.

items.spanish: Este acento es más fácil de entender que aquel.
items.english: This accent is easier to understand than that one.

items.spanish: Las dos variedades son tan interesantes como la otra.
items.english: The two varieties are as interesting as each other.

items.spanish: Hablar despacio es tan útil como hablar rápido cuando quieres que te entiendan.
items.english: Speaking slowly is as useful as speaking fast when you want to be understood.
